name: B&B Hotel zur Schanz
beschreibung: The B&B Hotel zur Schanz inn is situated in Ebbs in the Tyrolean Unterland. The accommodation is conveniently located near the border with Germany. The house offers guests comfortable rooms and a daily breakfast buffet. During pleasant weather, the outdoor guest garden invites visitors to linger and unwind. The surrounding area is characterized by the Ebbs Moor (Ebbser Moor) and the dramatic Kaisergebirge mountains. Hiking and cycling trails are within easy reach of the property. The inn is well suited for both short stopovers and longer holidays. The hosts place great importance on personalized hospitality and regional produce.
